steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: I've sent Pedro and the others away, so no one will be coming to the camp for now.

steps.name: Sommer
steps.text: Eirene, you were with Judge Lavinia last night. Do you know how badly Leontuzzo is injured? Is he...?

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: They were able to rescue him from the crash site last night, but his condition is not good.
The trucker slumps into the chair like a deflated balloon, covering his face with his dirty gloves.

steps.name: Sommer
steps.text: He's still so young, and such a good man... Please, don't let anything happen to him—ah, I really...!

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: What happened, actually?

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: Was it an accident?

steps.name: Sommer
steps.text: I, I don't know. I was just driving along, and all of a sudden, my steering wheel wouldn't turn right.

steps.name: Sommer
steps.text: I didn't have time to react and crashed the truck. By the time I came to, it was all over...

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: But... even if you panicked at the moment, you shouldn't have left a critically injured person by the roadside and driven away!

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: Do you realize that if first responders had arrived just a few minutes later, Leontuzzo would have...

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: I know you're not like that.

steps.name: Sommer
steps.text: Sorry, Eirene. I really wanted to help him. I know I should have helped him. I'm not a bad guy.

steps.name: Sommer
steps.text: But, but I had to drive off.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: Why?

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: Sommer, talk to me!

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: What was in that truck?
Eirene's voice starts to tremble. The driver, slumped in his chair, looks pale.

steps.name: Sommer
steps.text: I'm sorry, Eirene...

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: Sommer, who were you driving that truck for?

steps.name: Sommer
steps.text: Venezia Trucking... Famiglia Venezia.
The silence hangs in the air for what seems like forever. Then, Eirene finally speaks.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: Is this because of Guri?

steps.name: Sommer
steps.text: Don't try to justify it, Eirene. I know I made a huge mistake.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: Why? Why go to them rather than seek help from the Truckers' Union?

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: You're the most senior trucker in the union. You know how unique our situation is in Nuova Volsinii—both City Hall and the famiglie are watching us like hawks.

steps.name: Sommer
steps.text: Eirene, we all know how expensive Oripathy medication is.

steps.name: Sommer
steps.text: Besides, once I bring Guri to Nuova Volsinii, between settling her in and getting her into a good school... who knows how much all of that will cost?

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: I'm here too, aren't I? I can help. You're the one who saved me back in Sicilia. Guri is my sister too.

steps.name: Sommer
steps.text: Eirene, the union can't help me fix this.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: So you're gonna do it by yourself...?

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: Goods shipped in from other cities or shipments between local merchants, every item we touch must be registered in advance.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: In the past six months, I've personally reviewed every single schedule, and we've passed all routine inspections. How could you alone have managed to—could it be that...?

steps.name: Sommer
steps.text: I'm not doing this alone, Eirene.

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: So none of you know where Sommer went?

steps.name: Truck Driver
steps.text: Is it possible he already ran back to Sicilia under cover of darkness? I mean, he did hit the Acting Mayor's car, you know!

steps.name: Truck Driver
steps.text: The police are going to throw everything they have at this case. Will we be exposed? Smuggling contraband is a red line for City Hall, especially since we were doing it to help you...

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: No, no. This has nothing to do with Venezia Trucking.

steps.name: Truck Driver
steps.text: What? You mean, you're gonna tie up all the 'loose ends'?

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: 'Tie up loose ends'? Spoken like a true wise guy. Haha.

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: But no, I'm not. Relax. Do you see me carrying any weapons? Just keep your mouth shut, and everything will be fine. Capisce?

steps.name: Truck Driver
steps.text: But what if the cops start breathing down our necks?

steps.name: Truck Driver
steps.text: We've been hiding this stuff from Eirene and getting sweated by City Hall all this time. If something really does happen, you can't just wash your hands of all this!

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: (Shrugs)

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: If you really wanna pick nits here, we are even less to blame.

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: Venezia Trucking has never violated the 'New Urban Management Act', nor has it ever tried to infiltrate the Truckers' Union or interfere with Nuova Volsinii's logistics system.

steps.name: Truck Driver
steps.text: What do you mean?

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: Sommer wants to bring his daughter here to treat her for Oripathy, right?

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: He already found a good hospital, but he can't afford to pay for the treatment. Instead, he's using union trucks as private hospital vehicles to help the Logistics Department transport goods.

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: Venezia Trucking is at the bottom of the list, when it comes to that Hospital's financial backers. We have no connection to Sommer, apart from being in the same city.

steps.name: Truck Driver
steps.text: No. That's not true.

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: And you, you're just a drunk who can't even sit up straight in the driver's seat half the time. You had to secretly hire someone to drive for you just to keep your job.

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: We signed a service agreement, I'll have you know! I'm just a driver-for-hire trying to make some extra cash.

steps.name: Truck Driver
steps.text: I was sick! They had to put me on painkillers!

steps.name: Truck Driver
steps.text: You got some kind of leverage over every single truck driver you approach.

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: Nuova Volsinii values the rule of law. We can go to court and present the evidence piece by piece. Then we'll see whose hands are clean.

steps.name: Truck Driver
steps.text: You—you people are even scarier without weapons!

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: Really? I'm glad you say that, because I used to think I looked like a dork quoting laws like that.

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: Alright. Calm down everyone.

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: Enough threats. Let's just fix this. You guys go find our 'tires', and we'll handle the rest.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: ...How long has it been?

steps.name: Sommer
steps.text: They found me six months ago. I reckon that they'd already dealt with a few dozen other drivers before then.

steps.name: Sommer
steps.text: What choice did we have? Running even one shipment for them pays more than we earn in a month.

steps.name: Sommer
steps.text: Besides, if we don't cooperate, they have plenty of ways to push us right out of this city.

steps.name: Sommer
steps.text: After Signora Sicilia took power, she implemented all these reforms, in all of Siracusa's cities. The cunning guys adapted to the new rules far faster than we did...

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: Are you speaking for yourself, or for others?

steps.name: Sommer
steps.text: Eirene, I beg you, help us!

steps.name: Sommer
steps.text: I promise you! Once Carnevale is over, we'll never smuggle anything for those goons ever again!

steps.name: Sommer
steps.text: You can turn me in, but please, you have to help the others. They really had no choice but to—

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: ....The list of names.

steps.name: Sommer
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: Don't try and fool me. If you guys were doing this stuff, you had to have made a list of names. Give it to me.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: ...At least tell me how many of you there are. Then I'll try and see what I can do.
Sommer puts down the lighter he has been clutching and begins searching through his pockets.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: Sommer, why do you still have that lighter? I thought you quit smoking.

steps.name: Sommer
steps.text: It was a gift from you. I'm used to carrying it around.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: Actually, I found it lying around near the supermarket. There's no way I could afford to buy such an expensive lighter.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: Do you remember? After Guri's mother passed away, you took over that supermarket, managing the business while raising your child. Then one day, you found me, homeless, at your doorstep.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: You always say you just took in a delivery driver and cashier who didn't ask for a salary, but I know you actually gave me a place to stay—a home.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: Later, Famiglia Tocco set their sights on us. They were just a small family, but even after we stocked their products, they wouldn't let up. They threatened us, demanding we remove their competitors' items from the shelves.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: We told them we'd consider their request, but then that same night, a huge fire broke out in the supermarket, which is how Guri contracted Oripathy.

steps.name: Sommer
steps.text: That's all in the past. Why are you bringing it up now?

steps.name: Sommer
steps.text: I found it. Here you are.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: Carmelo, Gianni, Ruggiero. What a surprise.

steps.name: Sommer
steps.text: ...Sorry.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: Don't say any more, Sommer. Go to the storehouse. There is a wooden crate behind that truck that's being repaired. Bring it to me.

steps.name: Sommer
steps.text: But that's...everything you own, isn't it?

steps.name: Sommer
steps.text: Alright... alright.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: Sommer, what you don't know is, I found that lighter right next to the scene of the supermarket fire.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: We came to Nuova Volsinii because we had nothing.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: Everyone makes mistakes at some point...

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: But I can't let you destroy all of this.

steps.name: Private Physician
steps.text: Judge Lavinia.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: I'm here to see Leon.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: I need to ask you all a favor—do not disclose Leon's condition to outsiders. This info is strictly need-to-know.

steps.name: Private Physician
steps.text: Sure. I understand.
It seems I'm in the right place.

steps.name: Private Physician
steps.text: Who are you looking for? This is a special ward. You can't just barge in here!

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: No, it's ok. Let her come in.

steps.name: Private Physician
steps.text: Well then, I'll get going. Please find me if you need anything.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: ...Texas.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Long time no see.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Long time no see.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: I just grabbed some millefoglie and macaroni downstairs. Have a bite if you're hungry—I'll keep an eye on Leontuzzo for now.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: I received your invitation.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: We never heard back from you. We assumed you weren't planning to return to Nuova Volsinii.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: I was busy.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Croissant is busy pushing Bison into organizing some new international project, Sora is only halfway through her tour of Siracusa, and Exusiai—who knows where she's run off to this time?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: I've been managing Penguin Logistics myself this whole time, with far fewer staff and no fewer orders.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Besides, these crowded celebrations really don't excite me. I prefer just stopping by when I'm on a delivery, assuming it's on the way.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Then what brings you here today?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: What can I do? I have a boss who loves a good crowd. One night, he happened to spot that invitation and had me pack my bags on the spot.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: He's very interested in the 'themed party' you're hosting. He cleared his calendar, shut down 'The Ends of the Earth' for two weeks, and dragged me here all the way from Lungmen.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Relax, Lavinia. You seem so tense.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Leon, he...

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: I've been briefed on it.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: It wasn't an accident?

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: The police are still investigating. I just got back from the scene... I don't think it was an accident.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Persons of interest?

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: The usual suspects?

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Uhuh.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Why?

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: On the night of the Carnevale parade, Leon was supposed to officially announce his appointment as mayor of Nuova Volsinii at the front of the procession.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: It's not a strange decision, per se, but he did seem a bit too eager.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Even if he abandoned his family, he is still Bernardo Bellone's son. One year is not enough for people to forget the turmoil Bernardo once stirred in Volsinii.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Staying behind the scenes makes it easier for him to keep the government functioning. This is the safest approach. It's much better than him changing clothes, putting down his defensive staff, and stepping back into the spotlight.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Nuova Volsinii has only been around for a year and he's barely managing to hold onto his position as Acting Mayor, even with Signora Sicilia's backing.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: I told him all of this already.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: ...Right.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Lavinia, your comms device has been flashing for a while now.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Did they find new evidence?

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: No, it's a message from the court. We have a case...

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: That's kind of tricky?

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Uhuh.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Honestly, I understand why Leon was in such a hurry.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: This year, the changes in Nuova Volsinii can be seen with the naked eye. Many things that once existed only in our imagination have now become a reality.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Isn't that what Signora Sicilia wanted?

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Well, but it's not enough; not nearly enough. We must show our presence to promote more changes.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: So I stopped trying to persuade him, but then...

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: You're still the same as before—no, even more naive than back then. It's kind of nice.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Texas, do you want to come with me?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: To the court?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: You know I'm not interested in crowded celebrations, much less official duties involving mountains of paperwork.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: I'm going to stay here and ensure Leon's safety. Right now, there's no one better suited to the job, right?

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Thank you, Texas.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: To be honest, if you had stayed with me in Nuova Volsinii back then—

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: I told you before, when my friends are in trouble, I'll come to help.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: I'm here, aren't I?
